name: SpendWise
status: Built (iOS/watchOS ~20.8K Swift LOC, Android ~13.3K Kotlin LOC). Push backend designed and built but not production-deployed: device tokens in a local JSON file; Pub/Sub topic still a placeholder.
description: Privacy-first personal finance tracker for iPhone, Apple Watch, and Android that reads bank alert emails via the Gmail API and turns them into categorized transactions, with all financial data kept on device.
do_not_claim: Multiple bank support (only HDFC parser built)
source: User-supplied code review summary of the SpendWise codebases, 2026-11-15.
